title: Cosmic Selfie in Enchanted Realm
description: A woman with purple flowing hair and glowing body markings sits on a bed taking a selfie with a decorated smartphone. She wears a colorful bikini while ethereal butterflies, floating books, and a massive gnarled magical tree frame a surreal fantasy landscape with a distant castle under a starry, cracked-sky cosmos.
prompt: A beautiful woman with long flowing purple and teal hair sits on a bed in a surreal fantasy realm, taking a selfie with her smartphone. She wears a bright orange and green bikini, her skin covered in glowing patterns. Magical butterflies and floating open books surround her. A giant ancient tree with glowing runes frames a view of a distant fantasy castle under a vibrant cosmic sky with planets and cracked glowing orbs.
